profile.headline: Software Engineer At Beacon Interactive Systems
profile.summary: Highly skilled software development professional bringing more than 10 years of experience in designing, implementing, shipping and deploying software using .NET Framework. Prioritize urgency of issues to meet hotfix release deadlines. Employ outstanding problem solving and communication skills with escalations and non-technical audience in delivering full scale IT solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and maintained custom applications for customers utilizing C# and MySQL Database. Performed new software development, investigated and fixed issues in Bravado Health lead application.

positions.title: IT System Analyst / Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop and implement windows applications utilizing Visual Basic. Work closely with senior developers to make much-needed changes to Cablecom’s Front end, coordinate various database migrations and handle technical troubleshooting, including system crashes, slow-downs and data recoveries. 

	Applied software engineering education to develop 30+ applications/modules in Visual Basic .net/6.0 and Crystal Reports 
	Created and maintained various databases and documentation on production and development environments using SQL Server 2000/2012 and MS Access.
	Performed helpdesk services for CableCom’s 20+ offices, investigated reported issues and walked users through service protocols to rule out numerous problems.
	Led updates and installations of 400+ new desktop/laptops systems for developers, project managers, and other team members.
positions.insights: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET), Microsoft SQL Server and +2 skills
